title: StepInput
description: Immutable, re-readable snapshot of everything given to one model step. Backend-owned; never produced by a model. Output identifiers are checked against this step's allowlist, not against the shared library.

work_id.description: Work family. Versions sharing a work_id are not independent evidence.

abstract_origin.description: Origin of abstract text (for example provider_openalex_inverted_index, publisher_pdf, user). Null for non-abstract passages.

text_source.description: How a PDF passage's text was obtained: the PDF's own text layer, local OCR of a scanned page, Marker's reading of a page with mathematics (equations as LaTeX), or latex_source: the PDF's own text in which one or more displayed equations numbered on the page were replaced by the authors' LaTeX from the arXiv source of the same version, matched to the page by number and letters. OCR and Marker text can misread characters and symbols. Null for abstracts.

claims_under_review.description: answer_review steps only: the claims of the answer being reviewed. Each claim's passages are in passages.

extraction_target.description: cell_extraction and table_columns steps only: the evidence table and its columns. A cell_extraction step reads the passages of source_id only; table_columns has no source_id or passage_scope.

columns.description: cell_extraction: the columns to answer. table_columns: the table's current columns.

passage_scope.description: How much of the source's stored text the step was given. all_pages_given: every extracted PDF passage was given, which is still not a reading of the whole publication.

screening_target.description: abstract_screening steps only: how many independent runs read this batch and which of them this call is. The two runs get the same records and the same instructions; nothing else distinguishes them.

adjudication_target.description: fulltext_adjudication steps only: one work, the inclusion criterion and its parts, and which of the two runs this call is. The two runs get the same passages and the same parts.

inclusion_role.description: Core gates inclusion; aspect records contribution only. Absent on legacy plans, where every part gates inclusion.

role.description: Set by code on the part the question names as the comparator (slice 28); the method reads that part by what the comparison group receives.

vocabulary_target.description: vocabulary_labels steps only: the question and the exact phrase list code extracted from it, each with the block the code rule put it in. The step sorts these phrases and may not change the list.

rule_block.description: Where the code rule put the phrase. It is shown as context, not as an answer to copy.

advice_target.description: term_advice steps only: the question, the searched terms of the approval's proposal, and the terms the card warns about with the matches the search has with and without each. The step advises on the warned terms and may name no other phrase.

searched_terms.description: Every searched term of the two blocks, in the order the vocabulary was built in.

matches.description: Indexed records the search matches as it stands.

matches_without_term.description: Indexed records it would match with this one term taken out.

suggestion_target.description: term_suggestions steps only: the question, the searched phrases of the approval's proposal with the records that hold each one, and the phrases the search keeps out deliberately. The step proposes other names for the given phrases and may name no other phrase in synonym_of.

phrases.description: Every phrase of the two searched blocks, in the order the vocabulary was built in, dropped ones included: a phrase no record holds is the one the field most likely calls something else.

block.description: The searched block the phrase sits in. A proposed name inherits it; the step does not choose a block.

records.description: Indexed records holding the phrase. Null was not counted, which is not zero.

avoid.description: The proposal's other phrases (claim words, exclusion words, outcome terms). They are out of the query deliberately (SW1.3); a proposal carrying one is dropped by code.

validation_context.description: Frozen validation context only; never grants citation permissions. Serialized context cap: 262144 characters; exceeding it fails the section without truncation. VII includes accepted VI gaps and their basis evidence.

columns.description: The evidence table's columns, so the plan step can tie an axis to a real column and a section step can name one.

plan.description: report_plan (this validates the plan the model just wrote, before code appends corpus/section_budgets/allowed_support): null. report_section and report_phrase_repair: the frozen plan. report_review: null (review reads sections directly, not the plan echo).

cells.description: Selected records from the frozen report snapshot. Cell and revision identifiers pin each value and its source-owned evidence quotes; an empty array is valid when a step needs no cells.

gap_candidates.description: Code-generated corpus_absence candidates for VI from the same frozen cells; other steps receive an empty array. The model writes candidate prose but cannot mint this kind's basis.

prior_summaries.description: report_section only: code-written one-line summaries of already-valid sections this call may build on (§4: 'özetleri kod üretir').
